newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy steady to firmer, corn flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy steady to firmer, corn flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were steady to one cent a bushel firmer on Tuesday while corn and wheat values were unchanged, export sources said.
Dealers noted scaled-back demand and slow movement due to cold weather in parts of the Midwest.

In export news, India was scheduled to seek late Tuesday 50,000 tonnes or more of optional-origin wheat for March arrival, several U.S. exporters said. Sri Lanka is expected to seek on February 6, 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat.

Also, Egypt's main wheat buyer said he was seeking bids for 50,000 tonnes of Argentine, U.S. or French wheat. The wheat would be loaded in March or April and could be of any variety. The deadline for bids is 8 a.m. local (0600 GMT) on February 1.
